description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (in percentage) of two large vision-language models—Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two supervision conditions: “Strong Supervision” (represented by blue bars with diagonal hatching) and “Weak Supervision” (represented by solid light purple bars). The vertical y-axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, ranges from 0 to 30 with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal x-axis lists the two models as categorical groups. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, strong supervision yields approximately 24.5% performance gain, while weak supervision yields about 5%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, strong supervision results in approximately 15% gain, and weak supervision yields about 5.5%. The chart visually emphasizes that strong supervision consistently leads to substantially higher performance gains than weak supervision for both models, with Claude-3.5-Sonnet showing the largest gain under strong supervision. The legend at the top clarifies the color and pattern coding for the two supervision types.
